explication: Telegram for Android is a mobile messaging client. The broad user workflow is starting the app, accessing messaging features, and exchanging content through Telegram’s service; the README establishes the product but does not document that runtime wiring in detail. Sampled sources show concrete group-call messaging, native wallet bridging, and WebRTC video-stream handling. The graph preserves major runtime modules named by the SOURCE INDEX, but many are not present in the supplied tree excerpt; relationships are limited to those explicitly visible in excerpts or documented in the README.
